Title: To Unpathed Waters
Description: Collect firefly bait for Perronelle le Noir.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You can't… fish!? That is horrible to hear! It is such a pleasure. Life is difficult, no? Even the smallest things… out of reach. But when you fish, you can reflect.
InProgressResponse: Listen! Can you hear them? The fish, they call out, 'Catch me!' Ha ha!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You see! Very simple, very simple to do. Also… I need no charity; so… ah, for you. Your first fishing pole! She is… old and weathered, yes. But… very capable still!

Title: And Undreamed Shores
Description: Cast, hook, and reel in three fish for Perronelle.
PlayerPrompt: "A creative way to look at it."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ha ha! Yes, you get it, don't you!? The vision. Start with a humble pond, and you'll soon graduate to the great, wide ocean! There you may find the masterpiece.
InProgressResponse: Ah, Aeternum. Is it not the land of fish? I see it… so clearly, everywhere I go.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Fantastic, fantastic. You have been busy with your reel. A master fisher in the making indeed. A burgeoning artist, I might even say.

Title: The Good Squire
Description: See Perronelle's assistant, Khadijah Bahri, to continue the fishing quests
ObjectiveProposalResponse: La Lueur, indeed! Even after I say these silly things… still you are eager to continue onwards. There is knightly spirit in you. Oh yes, I can see your glimmer now.
InProgressResponse: Like all true fishers of life, Khadijah is a student of the waters. Much yet to learn, but a keen eye for technique!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_smallSingleWave" />Oh hello! Rather unusual for someone to find me over here. <g id="female_explainS" />Not that it's much of a secret fishing hole, mind you, it's simply more dangerous around these parts.

Title: This Melancholy Bait
Description: Catch something other than fish, namely one Snail in Fresh Water and one Clam in Salt Water. Next, salvage them for resources.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Captain Perronelle? <g id="female_covermouthShocked" />Ohh… <g id="male_hanghead" />I thought this might happen. Just… not so soon. <g id="female_crying" />She carried such a weight, she hid it well, but… what can we do?
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />My test has multiple steps: following guidance, utilizing skills, working with others. And my personal suggestion: <g id="female_whattheheck" />have fun with it!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_nodConsider" />Caught us some snails and clams, have you? Mmm. <g id="female_headnodding" />Pretty ones, too. Grand work, all around. <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />Feels great being out on the water, yeah?

Title: The Idle Squire
Description: See Perronelle's other assistant, Urashima Ishii, to continue the fishing quests
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugShort" />Something like that. Go find Urashima. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />He's the "other" squire. A hotshot by his own estimation, <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />but a bit of a laze, in my opinion. You'll learn something, though!
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_gestureForward01" />Check in with Urashima and we'll be closer to knowing if you have what it takes to be a <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Seeker of the Questing Bass!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_shrugBrief" />In life, you're either the fish or the worm. <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />Or the person eating the fish. Or the… um. Wait, what was I talking about… <g id="male_lookaroundStartled01" />Wait! Who are YOU?

Title: Thou Deboshed Fish!
Description: Increase your catch rate by fishing from a Hotspot three times.
PlayerPrompt: "Teach me and I'll share the load."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />If I had another pair of hands, and another fishing pole, I might finish my quota. And then I could finally sleep!<g id="male_spreadarms001" /> How many days has it been. Wait! <g id="female_gestureForward01" />Who ARE you?
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />As our fearless leader would say: Carpe Diem. That's French for 'catch fish all day', right? <g id="male_shakehead" />Or is that French for 'hotspots'? I can't remember.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />Not a bad haul, I admit. Only a fraction of what I needed.<g id="male_laugh" /> Haaa… I pace myself for sanity's sake. Unlike Perronelle, <g id="male_shakehead" />who won't take a break to save her life.

Title: Gilded Tombs do Worms Enfold
Description: Help Urashima with his work by catching fifteen fish anywhere.
PlayerPrompt: "I can finish the job for you."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_laugh" />Ambitious, aren't you? <g id="female_nodConsider" />But you do have a knack for this… yes, help me get this done and I will sing your praises to Perronelle.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_nodConsider" />I once saw a fish eat another fish. And then I'm thinking, what if there's always a bigger fish? <g id="female_lookConcern" />Where is the biggest fish right now? <g id="female_turnleftStartleSimple" />Are we inside it?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Aha! So glad you came back… <g id="female_nodConsider" />and look at those fish! But that's not as important now. <g id="female_lookConcern" />Something… happened with Perronelle. <g id="male_shakehead" />She's gone mad.

Title: The Woe of Squires
Description: See Khadijah Bahri to get an update on Perronelle.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />Yes, please do. Without Perronelle, I'd… well, I don't know what, <g id="male_noway" priority="high" />but that's the problem! This could make her fall Lost. <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />You go and convince her to rest.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_dontknowS" />I wonder if she's doing this to herself because I'm not working fast enough… <g id="male_lookawayGuilty" />or my quality isn't high enough…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_lookConcern" />Nice to see a friendly face, even if I have sad news. <g id="male_dontknowS" />The order of The Seekers of the Questing Bass might be dissolved, once and for all.

Title: Rots From the Head Down
Description: Catch eight fish greater than 20 inches in length, for love of the craft. It's what Perronelle would want.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />Be my guest, but words won’t work. <g id="female_explainS" />Her wound. It never heals, you know? Gets worse and worse. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />She tries to hide how bad it is, but I can tell.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />Remember, only the biggest of fish will be enough to convince her! <g id="female_handsforwardRequest" />Do it for the Captain.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />You did it! I've been trying to catch some myself, <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />but they were all so small and pathetic looking.<g id="male_lookawayGuilty" /> I hate to say, but I was losing heart.

Title: The Regent's Wounds
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Nor I. When I came to Aeternum, everyone seemed self-interested, and uncaring. <g id="male_explain" />But the Captain always treated me right.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_beckonUrgent" priority="high" />Hurry on. Captain always likes to see the sheen of water on the scales when judging a catch. <g id="male_laugh" />Says she likes the shine of it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Agony… The agony! Damn you, Gladys… you thief! You stole my self from me… you stole… everything!

Title: Depths Close Round About
Description: Solve the mystery of Gladys by collecting one Squid Ink and one Catfish Whisker after salvaging Hooked Squid and Barbed Catfish.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: In my mind, in my pain… sinking into both depths. Down and down! Khadijah… too kind, I could not bring her. Urashima… too weary, I could not bring him. I am alone.
InProgressResponse: Ah… ahh… Where are you? I know you survive still. I know it! If only I could… cast… with all my might…!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_lookaroundWonder" />	I cannot believe this sight. And the air! <g id="male_lookUp" />Paaahh, how fresh it is! <g id="female_gestureForward01" />But who are you? <g id="female_turnleftStartleSimple" />What was that? <g id="male_spreadarms001" />What has happened?

Title: The Fisher King Returned
Description: Fish for the spawn of Gladys so that Pelles can scrape off their essence and save Perronelle.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_convince01" />The offspring of Gladys. Devil monsters, as she. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Monstrous fish with the potential to become gargantuan. <g id="female_explainS" />But within their gullets, the cure we need.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_beckonUrgent" priority="high" />Those devil fish! You must catch them quickly!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Did I not tell you? I would make myself whole. And look, Pelles is too. I have you to thank for both. You! Our newest Seeker of the Questing Bass!
